n8773.name: StarSubalgebra.exists_starAlgEquiv_matrix_and_finrank_of_isCentral
n8773.type_full:
∀ {n : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
  (S : StarSubalgebra Complex (Matrix n n Complex)) [Algebra.IsCentral Complex (Subtype fun x => Membership.mem S x)],
  Exists fun r =>

n9116.name: Matrix.exists_skew_unitary_congruence_of_paired_projectors
n9116.type_full:
∀ {κ : Type u_2} {m : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] [inst_2 : Fintype m]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq m] (P : κ → Matrix m m Complex) (E : κ → Real),
  (∀ (k : κ), Eq (P k).conjTranspose (P k)) →
    (∀ (a b : Sum κ κ),
        Eq (HMul.hMul (Sum.elim P (fun k => (P k).transpose) a) (Sum.elim P (fun k => (P k).transpose) b))
          (ite (Eq a b) (Sum.elim P (fun k => (P k).transpose) a) 0)) →
      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun a => Sum.elim P (fun k => (P k).transpose) a) 1 →
        have x :=
          Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
            HSMul.hSMul (Complex.exp (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg ↑(E k)) Complex.I)) (HSub.hSub (P k) (P k).transpose);
        Exists fun S =>
          Exists fun Λ =>
            And
              (Eq S
                (HSMul.hSMul (Complex.exp (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv (↑Real.pi) 4)) Complex.I))
                  (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
                    HSMul.hSMul (Complex.exp (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv (↑(E k)) 2)) Complex.I))
                      (HAdd.hAdd (P k) (P k).transpose))))
              (And (Eq Λ (HSMul.hSMul Complex.I (Finset.univ.sum fun k => HSub.hSub (P k) (P k).transpose)))
                (And (Eq S.transpose S)
                  (And (Membership.mem (Matrix.unitaryGroup m Complex) S)
                    (And (Eq (Λ.map ⇑(starRingEnd Complex)) Λ)
                      (And (Eq Λ.transpose (Neg.neg Λ))
                        (And (Membership.mem (Matrix.unitaryGroup m Complex) Λ)
                          (Eq x (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul S.transpose Λ) S))))))))

n9165.name: MPSTensor.CPSVCanonicalFormData.isCPSVBasisOfNormalTensors_iff_covered_and_minimal

  Iff (A.IsCPSVBasisOfNormalTensors fun j => ⟨dimB j, basis j⟩)
    (And (∀ (j : Fin g), (basis j).IsNormalTensor)
      (And
        (∀ (k : Fin data.r),
          Exists fun j =>
            Exists fun hdim =>
              Exists fun X =>
                Exists fun ζ =>
                  And (Eq (norm ζ) 1)
                    (∀ (i : Fin d),
                      Eq (data.blocks k i)
                        (HSMul.hSMul ζ (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (↑X) (cast ⋯ (basis j) i)) ↑(Inv.inv X)))))
        (∀ (j k : Fin g),
          Ne j k →
            ∀ (hdim : Eq (dimB j) (dimB k)),
              Not
                (Exists fun X =>
                  Exists fun ζ =>
                    And (Eq (norm ζ) 1)
                      (∀ (i : Fin d),
                        Eq (basis k i)
                          (HSMul.hSMul ζ (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (↑X) (cast ⋯ (basis j) i)) ↑(Inv.inv X))))))))

n9214.name: MPSTensor.exists_blockDecomp_of_commuting_projections_with_letter_and_isometry
n9214.type_full:
∀ {d D m : Nat} (A : MPSTensor d D) (P : Fin m → MatrixAlg D),
  (∀ (k : Fin m), IsOrthogonalProjection (P k)) →
    Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => P k) 1 →
      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (A i).conjTranspose (A i)) 1 →
        (∀ (k : Fin m) (i : Fin d), Eq (HMul.hMul (P k) (A i)) (HMul.hMul (A i) (P k))) →
          Exists fun dim =>
            Exists fun blocks =>
              Exists fun φ =>
                Exists fun V =>
                  And (∀ (k : Fin m), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (blocks k i).conjTranspose (blocks k i)) 1)
                    (And (A.SameMPV₂ (MPSTensor.toTensorFromBlocks (fun x => 1) blocks))
                      (And
                        (∀ (k : Fin m) (N : Nat) (σ : Fin N → Fin d),
                          Eq ((blocks k).mpv σ) (HMul.hMul (P k) (Kraus.evalWord A (List.ofFn σ))).trace)
                        (And
                          (∀ (k : Fin m) (X : Matrix (Fin (dim k)) (Fin (dim k)) Complex),
                            Eq (↑((φ k) ((Kraus.transferMap fun i => (blocks k i).conjTranspose) X)))
                              ((Kraus.transferMap fun i => (HMul.hMul (P k) (A i)).conjTranspose) ↑((φ k) X)))
                          (And
                            (∀ (k : Fin m) (X Y : Matrix (Fin (dim k)) (Fin (dim k)) Complex),
                              Eq (↑((φ k) (HMul.hMul X Y))) (HMul.hMul ↑((φ k) X) ↑((φ k) Y)))
                            (And
                              (∀ (k : Fin m) (X : Matrix (Fin (dim k)) (Fin (dim k)) Complex),
                                Eq (↑((φ k) X.conjTranspose)) (Matrix.conjTranspose ↑((φ k) X)))
                              (And
                                (∀ (k : Fin m) (i : Fin d),
                                  Eq (↑((φ k) (blocks k i))) (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (P k) (A i)) (P k)))
                                (And (∀ (k : Fin m), Eq (HMul.hMul (V k).conjTranspose (V k)) 1)
                                  (And (∀ (k : Fin m), Eq (HMul.hMul (V k) (V k).conjTranspose) (P k))
                                    (∀ (k : Fin m) (X : Matrix (Fin (dim k)) (Fin (dim k)) Complex),
                                      Eq (↑((φ k) X)) (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (V k) X) (V k).conjTranspose))))))))))

n9215.name: MPSTensor.exists_compressedTensor_of_supported_projection_with_letter_and_isometry
n9215.type_full:

    (∀ (i : Fin d), Eq (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul P (A i)) P) (A i)) →

        Exists fun n =>

                  (And (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (C i).conjTranspose (C i)) 1)
                    (And
                      (∀ (N : Nat) (σ : Fin N → Fin d),
                        Eq (C.mpv σ) (HMul.hMul P (Kraus.evalWord A (List.ofFn σ))).trace)

                        (∀ (X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Complex),

                        (And
                          (∀ (X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Complex),

n9544.name: MPSTensor.IsReduction.exists_boundary_dressed_proportional
n9544.type_full:
∀ {d D_A D_B : Nat} {B : MPSTensor d D_B} {A : MPSTensor d D_A} {V : Matrix (Fin D_A) (Fin D_B) Complex}
  {W : Matrix (Fin D_B) (Fin D_A) Complex} {V' : Matrix (Fin D_A) (Fin D_B) Complex}
  {W' : Matrix (Fin D_B) (Fin D_A) Complex},
  B.IsReduction A V W →
    B.IsReduction A V' W' →
      Kraus.IsNormal A →
        ∀ {N₀ : Nat},
          B.IsReductionResidualNilpotencyBound A V W N₀ →
            B.IsReductionResidualNilpotencyBound A V' W' N₀ →
              Exists fun z =>
                And (Ne z 0)
                  (∀ (w : List (Fin d)),
                    LT.lt (HMul.hMul 2 N₀) w.length →
                      And (Eq (HMul.hMul V (Kraus.evalWord B w)) (HSMul.hSMul z (HMul.hMul V' (Kraus.evalWord B w))))
                        (Eq (HMul.hMul (Kraus.evalWord B w) W)
                          (HSMul.hSMul (Inv.inv z) (HMul.hMul (Kraus.evalWord B w) W'))))

  (K : (s : ι) → MPOTensor d (bondDim s)) (P : ι → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Complex),
  (∀ (s : ι), IsOrthogonalProjection (P s)) →
    (∀ {s t : ι}, Ne s t → Eq (HMul.hMul (P s) (P t)) 0) →
      (∀ (s : ι) (β α : Fin (bondDim s)),
          And (Eq (HMul.hMul (P s) ((K s).physicalSlice β α)) ((K s).physicalSlice β α))
            (Eq (HMul.hMul ((K s).physicalSlice β α) (P s)) ((K s).physicalSlice β α))) →
        ∀ (boundary : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex → (s : ι) → Matrix (Fin (bondDim s)) (Fin (bondDim s)) Complex),
          (∀ (X : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex),
              Eq ((M.physCloseN 2) X) (Finset.univ.sum fun s => ((K s).physCloseN 2) (boundary X s))) →
            (∀ (X : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex),
                Eq ((M.physCloseN 4) X) (Finset.univ.sum fun s => ((K s).physCloseN 4) (boundary X s))) →
              (∀ (s : ι), (K s).blockTwo.IsRFPViaTS) →
                ∀ (ρTwo : Matrix (Fin 2 → Fin d) (Fin 2 → Fin d) Complex),
                  ρTwo.PosSemidef →
                    Eq ρTwo.trace 1 →
                      ∀ (ρFour : Matrix (Fin 4 → Fin d) (Fin 4 → Fin d) Complex),
                        ρFour.PosSemidef →
                          Eq ρFour.trace 1 →
                            Exists fun S =>
                              Exists fun T =>
                                And (IsKrausCPTP S)
                                  (And (IsKrausCPTP T)
                                    (And
                                      (∀ (X : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex),
                                        Eq (S ((M.physCloseN 4) X)) ((M.physCloseN 2) X))
                                      (∀ (X : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex),
                                        Eq (T ((M.physCloseN 2) X)) ((M.physCloseN 4) X))))

n9981.name: MPOTensor.hasIdempotentCoefficientForm_of_blockedRepresentations
n9981.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} {M : MPOTensor d D} (D₁ : M.CPSVVerticalDecomposition) (D₂ : M.blockTwo.CPSVVerticalDecomposition)
  (sigma : Equiv (Fin D₁.labelCount) (Fin D₂.labelCount)) (chi : MPOTensor.DiagonalChiFamily (Fin D₁.labelCount))
  (U :
    (α β : Fin D₁.labelCount) →
      Matrix (Sigma fun γ => Prod (Fin (chi.dim α β γ)) (Fin (D₁.bondDim γ)))
        (Fin (HMul.hMul (D₁.bondDim α) (D₁.bondDim β))) Complex),
  chi.PosEntries →
    (∀ (α β : Fin D₁.labelCount), Eq (HMul.hMul (U α β) (U α β).conjTranspose) 1) →
      (∀ (α β : Fin D₁.labelCount) (i j : Fin D),
          Eq
            (HMul.hMul
              (HMul.hMul (U α β)
                ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (D₁.tensor α)).mulTensor (MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (D₁.tensor β)) i j))
              (U α β).conjTranspose)
            (Matrix.blockDiagonal' fun γ =>
              Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) (chi.matrix α β γ)
                (MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (D₁.tensor γ) i j))) →
        (∀ (α β : Fin D₁.labelCount) (i j : Fin D),
            Eq ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (D₁.tensor α)).mulTensor (MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (D₁.tensor β)) i j)
              (HMul.hMul
                (HMul.hMul (U α β).conjTranspose
                  (Matrix.blockDiagonal' fun γ =>
                    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) (chi.matrix α β γ)
                      (MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (D₁.tensor γ) i j)))
                (U α β))) →
          (∀ (L : Nat),
              LT.lt 0 L →
                And
                  (Eq ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO M.blockTwo.verticalTensor).mpo L)
                    (Finset.univ.sum fun γ =>
                      HSMul.hSMul
                        (HMul.hMul
                          (HPow.hPow
                            (HDiv.hDiv (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace D₁.weight γ)
                              (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace D₂.weight (sigma γ)))
                            L)
                          (Finset.univ.sum fun r => HPow.hPow (D₂.weight (sigma γ) r) L))
                        ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (D₁.tensor γ)).mpo L)))
                  (Eq ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO M.blockTwo.verticalTensor).mpo L)
                    (Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
                      Finset.univ.sum fun β =>
                        HSMul.hSMul
                          (HMul.hMul (Finset.univ.sum fun q => HPow.hPow (D₁.weight α q) L)
                            (Finset.univ.sum fun r => HPow.hPow (D₁.weight β r) L))
                          (HMul.hMul ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (D₁.tensor α)).mpo L)
                            ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (D₁.tensor β)).mpo L))))) →
            (MPOTensor.verticalBNTTraceScalarFamily D₁.weight).HasIdempotentCoefficientForm
              (MPOTensor.BNTLabelCoefficientFamily.ofChi chi)

n10533.name: MPSTensor.IsCPSVCanonicalForm.exists_normalized_grouped_sector_maps
n10533.type_full:
∀ {d D r : Nat} {dim : Fin r → Nat} (blocks : (k : Fin r) → MPSTensor (HMul.hMul D D) (dim k)) {M : MPOTensor d D},
  M.toMPSTensor.IsCPSVCanonicalForm →
    M.IsMPDO →
      ∀ (mu : Fin r → Complex) (V : (k : Fin r) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (dim k)) Complex),
        (∀ (k : Fin r), LT.lt 0 (dim k)) →
          (∀ (k : Fin r), (blocks k).IsNormalTensor) →
            ∀
              (hdim :
                ∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g)
                  (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)),
                  Eq (dim ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).repr j))
                    (dim ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)))
              (X :
                (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g) →
                  (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)) →
                    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin (dim ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q))) Complex)
              (zeta :
                (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g) →
                  Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j) → Complex),
              (∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g), Eq (X j ⟨0, ⋯⟩) 1) →
                (∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g)
                    (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)),
                    LT.lt 0 (HMul.hMul (mu ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)) (zeta j q))) →
                  (∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g)
                      (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)),
                      Eq
                        (HMul.hMul (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)).conjTranspose
                          (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)))
                        1) →
                    (∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g)
                        (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j))
                        (l : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g)
                        (p : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies l)),
                        Ne ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)
                            ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum l p) →
                          Eq
                            (HMul.hMul (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)).conjTranspose
                              (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum l p)))
                            0) →
                      (∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g)
                          (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)) (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                          Eq (HMul.hMul (M.verticalTensor v) (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)))
                            (HMul.hMul (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q))
                              (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (mu ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)) (zeta j q))
                                (HMul.hMul
                                  (HMul.hMul (↑(X j q))
                                    (cast ⋯ (blocks ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).repr j)) v))
                                  ↑(Inv.inv (X j q)))))) →
                        (∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g)
                            (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)) (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                            Eq
                              (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (mu ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)) (zeta j q))
                                (HMul.hMul
                                  (HMul.hMul (↑(X j q))
                                    (cast ⋯ (blocks ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).repr j)) v))
                                  ↑(Inv.inv (X j q))))
                              (HMul.hMul
                                (HMul.hMul (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)).conjTranspose
                                  (M.verticalTensor v))
                                (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)))) →
                          (∀ (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                              Eq (M.verticalTensor v)
                                (Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
                                  Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
                                    HMul.hMul
                                      (HMul.hMul (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q))
                                        (HSMul.hSMul
                                          (HMul.hMul (mu ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)) (zeta j q))
                                          (HMul.hMul
                                            (HMul.hMul (↑(X j q))
                                              (cast ⋯ (blocks ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).repr j)) v))
                                            ↑(Inv.inv (X j q)))))
                                      (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)).conjTranspose)) →
                            Exists fun omega =>
                              Exists fun W =>
                                And
                                  (∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g)
                                    (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)), LT.lt 0 (omega j q))
                                  (And
                                    (∀ (p : Sigma fun j => Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)),
                                      Eq (HMul.hMul (W p).conjTranspose (W p)) 1)
                                    (And
                                      (∀ (p q : Sigma fun j => Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)),
                                        Ne p q → Eq (HMul.hMul (W p).conjTranspose (W q)) 0)
                                      (And
                                        (∀ (p : Sigma fun j => Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j))
                                          (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                          Eq (HMul.hMul (M.verticalTensor v) (W p))
                                            (HMul.hMul (W p)
                                              (HSMul.hSMul
                                                (HMul.hMul (mu ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum p.fst p.snd))
                                                  (zeta p.fst p.snd))
                                                (blocks ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).repr p.fst) v))))
                                        (∀ (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                          Eq (M.verticalTensor v)
                                            (Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
                                              Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
                                                HMul.hMul
                                                  (HMul.hMul (W ⟨j, q⟩)
                                                    (HSMul.hSMul
                                                      (HMul.hMul (mu ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q))
                                                        (zeta j q))
                                                      (blocks ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).repr j) v)))
                                                  (W ⟨j, q⟩).conjTranspose)))))

n10892.name: Matrix.exists_positive_etaPair_decomposition_of_overlappingLifts_commute

        (HMul.hMul B.rightOverlappingLift B.leftOverlappingLift) →

        Exists fun dl =>

                    (And (∀ (q : Fin K), LT.lt 0 (dl q))

                              (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (star (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) U U)) B)
                                (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) U U)))

                (Fus.inversePrintedFMatrix a h d e ⟨g, Prod.mk lambda rho⟩ ⟨i, Prod.mk omega kappa⟩))
              (Fus.inversePrintedFMatrix b c d i ⟨h, Prod.mk sigma omega⟩ ⟨j, Prod.mk gamma delta⟩))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun tau =>
      HMul.hMul (Fus.inversePrintedFMatrix f c d e ⟨g, Prod.mk nu rho⟩ ⟨j, Prod.mk gamma tau⟩)

n10987.name: MPOTensor.exists_displaced_invariant_projector_of_periodic_vector
n10987.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} (M : MPOTensor d D) {n : Nat} (V : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin n) Complex) (B : MPSTensor (HMul.hMul D D) n)
  (ρ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Complex) (rad : Real),
  Eq (HMul.hMul V.conjTranspose V) 1 →
    (∀ (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)), Eq (HMul.hMul (M.verticalTensor v) V) (HMul.hMul V (B v))) →
      Kraus.IsIrreducibleFamily B →
        ρ.PosDef →
          LT.lt 0 rad →
            Eq ((Kraus.transferMap B) ρ) (HSMul.hSMul (↑rad) ρ) →
              ∀ (μ : Complex),
                Module.End.HasEigenvalue (Kraus.transferMap B) μ →
                  Eq (norm μ) rad →
                    Ne μ ↑rad →
                      Exists fun p =>
                        Exists fun Q =>
                          And (Ne p 0)
                            (And Q.IsHermitian
                              (And (IsIdempotentElem Q)
                                (And
                                  (∀ (w : List (Fin (HMul.hMul D D))),
                                    Eq w.length p →
                                      Eq (HMul.hMul Q (Kraus.evalWord M.verticalTensor w))
                                        (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul Q (Kraus.evalWord M.verticalTensor w)) Q))
                                  (Ne (M.ketLeftMul Q) ((M.ketLeftMul Q).braRightMul Q)))))

n10991.name: MPSTensor.spectralUnitalGauge_schwarz_setup
n10991.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} [NeZero D] (B : MPSTensor d D),
  Kraus.IsIrreducibleFamily B →

            Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j) → Complex),

                    (P j (ρ 0).modNat))) →
          (∀ (N : Nat) (ρ : Fin (HAdd.hAdd N 1) → Fin (HMul.hMul d d)),

n11386.name: MPOTensor.exists_normalized_grouped_sector_maps_of_gram
n11386.type_full:
∀ {d D r : Nat} {dim : Fin r → Nat} (blocks : (k : Fin r) → MPSTensor (HMul.hMul D D) (dim k)) {M : MPOTensor d D}
  (mu : Fin r → Complex) (V : (k : Fin r) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (dim k)) Complex)
  (hdim :
    ∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g) (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)),
      Eq (dim ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).repr j)) (dim ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)))
  (X :
    (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g) →
      (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)) →
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin (dim ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q))) Complex)
  (zeta :
    (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g) → Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j) → Complex),
  (∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g) (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)),
      Exists fun omega =>
        And (LT.lt 0 omega) (Eq (HMul.hMul (↑(X j q)).conjTranspose ↑(X j q)) (HSMul.hSMul (↑omega) 1))) →
    (∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g) (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)),
        Eq
          (HMul.hMul (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)).conjTranspose
            (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)))
          1) →
      (∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g) (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j))
          (l : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g) (p : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies l)),
          Ne ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q) ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum l p) →
            Eq
              (HMul.hMul (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)).conjTranspose
                (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum l p)))
              0) →
        (∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g) (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j))
            (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
            Eq (HMul.hMul (M.verticalTensor v) (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)))
              (HMul.hMul (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q))
                (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (mu ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)) (zeta j q))
                  (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (↑(X j q)) (cast ⋯ (blocks ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).repr j)) v))
                    ↑(Inv.inv (X j q)))))) →
          (∀ (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
              Eq (M.verticalTensor v)
                (Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
                  Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
                    HMul.hMul
                      (HMul.hMul (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q))
                        (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (mu ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)) (zeta j q))
                          (HMul.hMul
                            (HMul.hMul (↑(X j q)) (cast ⋯ (blocks ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).repr j)) v))
                            ↑(Inv.inv (X j q)))))
                      (V ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)).conjTranspose)) →
            Exists fun omega =>
              Exists fun W =>
                And
                  (∀ (j : Fin (MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).g)
                    (q : Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)), LT.lt 0 (omega j q))
                  (And
                    (∀ (p : Sigma fun j => Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)),
                      Eq (HMul.hMul (W p).conjTranspose (W p)) 1)
                    (And
                      (∀ (p q : Sigma fun j => Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j)),
                        Ne p q → Eq (HMul.hMul (W p).conjTranspose (W q)) 0)
                      (And
                        (∀ (p : Sigma fun j => Fin ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).copies j))
                          (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                          Eq (HMul.hMul (M.verticalTensor v) (W p))
                            (HMul.hMul (W p)
                              (HSMul.hSMul
                                (HMul.hMul (mu ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum p.fst p.snd))
                                  (zeta p.fst p.snd))
                                (blocks ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).repr p.fst) v))))
                        (∀ (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                          Eq (M.verticalTensor v)
                            (Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
                              Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
                                HMul.hMul
                                  (HMul.hMul (W ⟨j, q⟩)
                                    (HSMul.hSMul
                                      (HMul.hMul (mu ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).enum j q)) (zeta j q))
                                      (blocks ((MPSTensor.mpvPhaseClassData blocks).repr j) v)))
                                  (W ⟨j, q⟩).conjTranspose)))))

n11492.name: MPOTensor.PhysicalSectorFactorization.activeSector_factorSupport_twoSided
n11492.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} {K : MPOTensor d D} (F : K.PhysicalSectorFactorization),
  Kraus.IsInjective K.toMPSTensor →
    (∀ (k h : Fin F.sectorCount), (F.neighboringOperator k h).PosSemidef) →
      ∀ {k : Fin F.sectorCount},
        F.IsActiveSector k →
          And
            (∀ (β : Fin D),
              And (Eq (HMul.hMul (F.leftFactorSupportProj k) (F.leftTensor k β)) (F.leftTensor k β))
                (Eq (HMul.hMul (F.leftTensor k β) (F.leftFactorSupportProj k)) (F.leftTensor k β)))
            (∀ (α : Fin D),
              And (Eq (HMul.hMul (F.rightFactorSupportProj k) (F.rightTensor k α)) (F.rightTensor k α))
                (Eq (HMul.hMul (F.rightTensor k α) (F.rightFactorSupportProj k)) (F.rightTensor k α)))

n11493.name: MPOTensor.PhysicalSectorFactorization.exists_activeSector_factorSupportIsometries
n11493.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} {K : MPOTensor d D} (F : K.PhysicalSectorFactorization) {k : Fin F.sectorCount},
  F.IsActiveSector k →
    Exists fun l =>
      Exists fun r =>
        Exists fun VL =>
          Exists fun VR =>
            And (LT.lt 0 l)
              (And (Eq (HMul.hMul VL.conjTranspose VL) 1)
                (And (Eq (HMul.hMul VL VL.conjTranspose) (F.leftFactorSupportProj k))
                  (And (LT.lt 0 r)
                    (And (Eq (HMul.hMul VR.conjTranspose VR) 1)
                      (Eq (HMul.hMul VR VR.conjTranspose) (F.rightFactorSupportProj k))))))

n11791.name: MPOTensor.exists_positiveFusionDecomposition_of_isRFPViaTS
n11791.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} (M : MPOTensor d D),
  M.IsHorizontalCF →
    M.IsMPDO →
      M.IsRFPViaTS →
        Exists fun g =>
          Exists fun dim =>
            Exists fun A =>
              And (M.verticalTensor.IsCPSVBasisOfNormalTensors fun α => ⟨dim α, A α⟩)
                (Exists fun chi =>
                  Exists fun U =>
                    And chi.PosEntries
                      (And (∀ (α β : Fin g), Eq (HMul.hMul (U α β) (U α β).conjTranspose) 1)
                        (And
                          (∀ (α β : Fin g) (i j : Fin D),
                            Eq
                              (HMul.hMul
                                (HMul.hMul (U α β)
                                  ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A α)).mulTensor (MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A β)) i j))
                                (U α β).conjTranspose)
                              (Matrix.blockDiagonal' fun γ =>
                                Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) (chi.matrix α β γ)
                                  (MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A γ) i j)))
                          (∀ (α β : Fin g) (i j : Fin D),
                            Eq ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A α)).mulTensor (MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A β)) i j)
                              (HMul.hMul
                                (HMul.hMul (U α β).conjTranspose
                                  (Matrix.blockDiagonal' fun γ =>
                                    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) (chi.matrix α β γ)
                                      (MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A γ) i j)))
                                (U α β))))))

n11911.name: MPOTensor.exists_explicitEtaOperators_sectorEta
n11911.type_full:

  (K : MPOTensor d D) (hK : K.IsInjective) (R : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex),
  K.IsThreeSiteClosure R ρ →
    ∀ (hη : MPOTensor.EtaStructure ρ) {α₁ β₃ : Fin D},
      Ne (R β₃ α₁) 0 →
        K.IsMPDO →
          (∀ (k h : Fin hη.m), Eq (K.sectorEta hK hη R α₁ β₃ k h) 0 → Eq (K.sectorEta hK hη R α₁ β₃ h k) 0) →
            Exists fun data =>
              And (∀ (k : Fin hη.m), Eq (data.eta k k) (K.sectorEta hK hη R α₁ β₃ k k))

                  (∀ (k h : Fin hη.m),
                    Exists fun c =>
                      And (Ne c 0)
                        (And (Eq (data.eta k h) (HSMul.hSMul c (K.sectorEta hK hη R α₁ β₃ k h)))
                          (Eq (data.eta h k) (HSMul.hSMul (Inv.inv c) (K.sectorEta hK hη R α₁ β₃ h k)))))
                  (∀ (k h : Fin hη.m),
                    Eq (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) (data.eta k h) (data.eta h k))
                      (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) (K.sectorEta hK hη R α₁ β₃ k h)
                        (K.sectorEta hK hη R α₁ β₃ h k))))

n11924.name: MPOTensor.physicalSlice_neighboring_contraction
n11924.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} (K : MPOTensor d D) (hK : K.IsInjective) (R : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex)
  (ρ : Matrix (Prod (Fin d) (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d))) (Prod (Fin d) (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d))) Complex),
  K.IsThreeSiteClosure R ρ →
    ∀ (hη : MPOTensor.EtaStructure ρ) {α₁ β₃ : Fin D},
      Ne (R β₃ α₁) 0 →
        ∀ (β₁ α₃ : Fin D) (k h : Fin hη.m) (l₁ l₁' : Fin (hη.dL k)) (r₁ r₁' : Fin (hη.dR k)) (l₂ l₂' : Fin (hη.dL h))
          (r₂ r₂' : Fin (hη.dR h)),
          Eq
            (Finset.univ.sum fun γ =>
              HMul.hMul
                ((Matrix.reindex hη.decompB hη.decompB)
                  (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (↑hη.U_B) (K.physicalSlice β₁ γ)) (↑hη.U_B).conjTranspose) ⟨k, Prod.mk l₁ r₁⟩
                  ⟨k, Prod.mk l₁' r₁'⟩)
                ((Matrix.reindex hη.decompB hη.decompB)
                  (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (↑hη.U_B) (K.physicalSlice γ α₃)) (↑hη.U_B).conjTranspose) ⟨h, Prod.mk l₂ r₂⟩
                  ⟨h, Prod.mk l₂' r₂'⟩))
            (HMul.hMul
              (HMul.hMul (K.sectorTensorL hK hη R α₁ β₃ k β₁ l₁ l₁')
                (K.sectorEta hK hη R α₁ β₃ k h (Prod.mk r₁ l₂) (Prod.mk r₁' l₂')))
              (K.sectorTensorR hK hη β₃ h α₃ r₂ r₂'))

n12333.name: MPOTensor.blockedVerticalOperatorRepresentations_of_unitaryBlockEquiv
n12333.type_full:
∀ {g₁ g₂ d D : Nat} (dim₁ mult₁ : Fin g₁ → Nat) (weight₁ : (α : Fin g₁) → Fin (mult₁ α) → Complex)
  (dim₂ mult₂ : Fin g₂ → Nat) (weight₂ : (β : Fin g₂) → Fin (mult₂ β) → Complex) (M : MPOTensor d D)
  (A₁ : (α : Fin g₁) → MPSTensor (HMul.hMul D D) (dim₁ α)) (A₂ : (β : Fin g₂) → MPSTensor (HMul.hMul D D) (dim₂ β))
  (U₁ : Matrix (Fin (Finset.univ.sum fun q => MPOTensor.verticalCopyDim dim₁ mult₁ q)) (Fin d) Complex)
  (U₂ : Matrix (Fin (Finset.univ.sum fun q => MPOTensor.verticalCopyDim dim₂ mult₂ q)) (Fin (HMul.hMul d d)) Complex),
  Eq (HMul.hMul U₁ U₁.conjTranspose) 1 →
    Eq (HMul.hMul U₂ U₂.conjTranspose) 1 →
      (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
          Eq (M.verticalTensor ab)
            (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul U₁.conjTranspose (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₁ mult₁ weight₁ A₁ ab)) U₁)) →
        (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
            Eq (M.blockTwo.verticalTensor ab)
              (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul U₂.conjTranspose (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₂ mult₂ weight₂ A₂ ab))
                U₂)) →
          ∀ (sigma : Equiv (Fin g₁) (Fin g₂)) (hDim : ∀ (i : Fin g₁), Eq (dim₁ i) (dim₂ (sigma i)))
            (V : (i : Fin g₁) → Subtype fun x => Membership.mem (Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin (dim₂ (sigma i))) Complex) x),
            (∀ (i : Fin g₁) (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                Eq (A₂ (sigma i) ab)
                  (HSMul.hSMul
                    (HDiv.hDiv (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace weight₁ i)
                      (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace weight₂ (sigma i)))
                    (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (↑(V i)) ((Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv Complex Complex (finCongr ⋯)) (A₁ i ab)))
                      (↑(V i)).conjTranspose))) →
              ∀ {L : Nat},
                LT.lt 0 L →
                  And
                    (Eq ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO M.blockTwo.verticalTensor).mpo L)
                      (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
                        HSMul.hSMul
                          (HMul.hMul
                            (HPow.hPow
                              (HDiv.hDiv (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace weight₁ i)
                                (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace weight₂ (sigma i)))
                              L)
                            (Finset.univ.sum fun q => HPow.hPow (weight₂ (sigma i) q) L))
                          ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A₁ i)).mpo L)))
                    (Eq ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO M.blockTwo.verticalTensor).mpo L)
                      (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
                        Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
                          HSMul.hSMul
                            (HMul.hMul (Finset.univ.sum fun q => HPow.hPow (weight₁ i q) L)
                              (Finset.univ.sum fun r => HPow.hPow (weight₁ j r) L))
                            (HMul.hMul ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A₁ i)).mpo L)
                              ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A₁ j)).mpo L))))

n12337.name: MPOTensor.transportedVerticalSector_exists_blockedOperatorRepresentations
n12337.type_full:
∀ {g₁ g₂ d D : Nat} (dim₁ mult₁ : Fin g₁ → Nat) (weight₁ : (α : Fin g₁) → Fin (mult₁ α) → Complex)
  (dim₂ mult₂ : Fin g₂ → Nat) (weight₂ : (β : Fin g₂) → Fin (mult₂ β) → Complex),
  (∀ (α : Fin g₁), LT.lt 0 (mult₁ α)) →
    (∀ (α : Fin g₁) (q : Fin (mult₁ α)), LT.lt 0 (weight₁ α q)) →
      (∀ (β : Fin g₂), LT.lt 0 (mult₂ β)) →
        (∀ (β : Fin g₂) (q : Fin (mult₂ β)), LT.lt 0 (weight₂ β q)) →
          ∀ (M : MPOTensor d D) (A₁ : (α : Fin g₁) → MPSTensor (HMul.hMul D D) (dim₁ α))
            (A₂ : (β : Fin g₂) → MPSTensor (HMul.hMul D D) (dim₂ β)),
            (M.verticalTensor.IsCPSVBasisOfNormalTensors fun α => ⟨dim₁ α, A₁ α⟩) →
              (M.blockTwo.verticalTensor.IsCPSVBasisOfNormalTensors fun β => ⟨dim₂ β, A₂ β⟩) →
                ∀ (U₁ : Matrix (Fin (Finset.univ.sum fun q => MPOTensor.verticalCopyDim dim₁ mult₁ q)) (Fin d) Complex)
                  (U₂ :
                    Matrix (Fin (Finset.univ.sum fun q => MPOTensor.verticalCopyDim dim₂ mult₂ q)) (Fin (HMul.hMul d d))
                      Complex),
                  Eq (HMul.hMul U₁ U₁.conjTranspose) 1 →
                    Eq (HMul.hMul U₂ U₂.conjTranspose) 1 →
                      ∀
                        (T :
                          LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Complex)
                            (Matrix (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d)) (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d)) Complex))
                        (S :
                          LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) (Matrix (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d)) (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d)) Complex)
                            (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Complex)),
                        IsKrausCPTP T →
                          IsKrausCPTP S →
                            (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                Eq (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul U₁ (M.verticalTensor ab)) U₁.conjTranspose)
                                  (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₁ mult₁ weight₁ A₁ ab)) →
                              (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                  Eq (M.verticalTensor ab)
                                    (HMul.hMul
                                      (HMul.hMul U₁.conjTranspose
                                        (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₁ mult₁ weight₁ A₁ ab))
                                      U₁)) →
                                (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                    Eq (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul U₂ (M.blockTwo.verticalTensor ab)) U₂.conjTranspose)
                                      (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₂ mult₂ weight₂ A₂ ab)) →
                                  (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                      Eq (M.blockTwo.verticalTensor ab)
                                        (HMul.hMul
                                          (HMul.hMul U₂.conjTranspose
                                            (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₂ mult₂ weight₂ A₂ ab))
                                          U₂)) →
                                    (∀ (X : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex), Eq (T (M.physClose1 X)) (M.physClose2 X)) →
                                      (∀ (X : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex),
                                          Eq (S (M.physClose2 X)) (M.physClose1 X)) →
                                        ∀ {L : Nat},
                                          LT.lt 0 L →
                                            Exists fun sigma =>
                                              Exists fun hDim =>
                                                Exists fun V =>
                                                  And
                                                    (∀ (i : Fin g₁) (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                                      Eq (A₂ (sigma i) ab)
                                                        (HSMul.hSMul
                                                          (HDiv.hDiv (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace weight₁ i)
                                                            (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace weight₂ (sigma i)))
                                                          (HMul.hMul
                                                            (HMul.hMul (↑(V i))
                                                              ((Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv Complex Complex (finCongr ⋯))
                                                                (A₁ i ab)))
                                                            (↑(V i)).conjTranspose)))
                                                    (And
                                                      (Eq ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO M.blockTwo.verticalTensor).mpo L)
                                                        (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
                                                          HSMul.hSMul
                                                            (HMul.hMul
                                                              (HPow.hPow
                                                                (HDiv.hDiv
                                                                  (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace weight₁ i)
                                                                  (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace weight₂
                                                                    (sigma i)))
                                                                L)
                                                              (Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
                                                                HPow.hPow (weight₂ (sigma i) q) L))
                                                            ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A₁ i)).mpo L)))
                                                      (Eq ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO M.blockTwo.verticalTensor).mpo L)
                                                        (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
                                                          Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
                                                            HSMul.hSMul
                                                              (HMul.hMul
                                                                (Finset.univ.sum fun q => HPow.hPow (weight₁ i q) L)
                                                                (Finset.univ.sum fun r => HPow.hPow (weight₁ j r) L))
                                                              (HMul.hMul ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A₁ i)).mpo L)
                                                                ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A₁ j)).mpo L)))))

          M.verticalTensor.IsBNT g dim A →
            ∀ (W : (p : Sigma fun α => Fin (mult α)) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (dim p.fst)) Complex),
              (∀ (p : Sigma fun α => Fin (mult α)), Eq (HMul.hMul (W p).conjTranspose (W p)) 1) →

n12409.type_full:

  (dim₂ mult₂ : Fin g₂ → Nat) (weight₂ : (β : Fin g₂) → Fin (mult₂ β) → Complex),
  (∀ (α : Fin g₁), LT.lt 0 (mult₁ α)) →
    (∀ (α : Fin g₁) (q : Fin (mult₁ α)), LT.lt 0 (weight₁ α q)) →
      (∀ (β : Fin g₂), LT.lt 0 (mult₂ β)) →
        (∀ (β : Fin g₂) (q : Fin (mult₂ β)), LT.lt 0 (weight₂ β q)) →
          ∀ (M : MPOTensor d D) (A₁ : (α : Fin g₁) → MPSTensor (HMul.hMul D D) (dim₁ α))
            (A₂ : (β : Fin g₂) → MPSTensor (HMul.hMul D D) (dim₂ β)),
            (M.verticalTensor.IsCPSVBasisOfNormalTensors fun α => ⟨dim₁ α, A₁ α⟩) →
              (M.blockTwo.verticalTensor.IsCPSVBasisOfNormalTensors fun β => ⟨dim₂ β, A₂ β⟩) →
                ∀ (U₁ : Matrix (Fin (Finset.univ.sum fun q => MPOTensor.verticalCopyDim dim₁ mult₁ q)) (Fin d) Complex)
                  (U₂ :
                    Matrix (Fin (Finset.univ.sum fun q => MPOTensor.verticalCopyDim dim₂ mult₂ q)) (Fin (HMul.hMul d d))
                      Complex),
                  Eq (HMul.hMul U₁ U₁.conjTranspose) 1 →
                    Eq (HMul.hMul U₂ U₂.conjTranspose) 1 →
                      ∀
                        (T :
                          LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Complex)
                            (Matrix (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d)) (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d)) Complex))
                        (Smap :
                          LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) (Matrix (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d)) (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d)) Complex)
                            (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Complex)),
                        IsKrausCPTP T →
                          IsKrausCPTP Smap →
                            (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                Eq (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul U₁ (M.verticalTensor ab)) U₁.conjTranspose)
                                  (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₁ mult₁ weight₁ A₁ ab)) →
                              (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                  Eq (M.verticalTensor ab)
                                    (HMul.hMul
                                      (HMul.hMul U₁.conjTranspose
                                        (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₁ mult₁ weight₁ A₁ ab))
                                      U₁)) →
                                (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                    Eq (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul U₂ (M.blockTwo.verticalTensor ab)) U₂.conjTranspose)
                                      (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₂ mult₂ weight₂ A₂ ab)) →
                                  (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                      Eq (M.blockTwo.verticalTensor ab)
                                        (HMul.hMul
                                          (HMul.hMul U₂.conjTranspose
                                            (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₂ mult₂ weight₂ A₂ ab))
                                          U₂)) →
                                    (∀ (X : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex), Eq (T (M.physClose1 X)) (M.physClose2 X)) →
                                      (∀ (X : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex),
                                          Eq (Smap (M.physClose2 X)) (M.physClose1 X)) →
                                        M.IsHorizontalCF →
                                          M.IsMPDO →
                                            Exists fun chi =>
                                              Exists fun U =>
                                                And chi.PosEntries
                                                  (And
                                                    (∀ (α β : Fin g₁), Eq (HMul.hMul (U α β) (U α β).conjTranspose) 1)
                                                    (And
                                                      (∀ (α β : Fin g₁) (i j : Fin D),
                                                        Eq
                                                          (HMul.hMul
                                                            (HMul.hMul (U α β)
                                                              ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A₁ α)).mulTensor
                                                                (MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A₁ β)) i j))
                                                            (U α β).conjTranspose)
                                                          (Matrix.blockDiagonal' fun γ =>
                                                            Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2)
                                                              (chi.matrix α β γ) (MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A₁ γ) i j)))
                                                      (∀ (α β : Fin g₁) (i j : Fin D),
                                                        Eq
                                                          ((MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A₁ α)).mulTensor
                                                            (MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A₁ β)) i j)
                                                          (HMul.hMul
                                                            (HMul.hMul (U α β).conjTranspose
                                                              (Matrix.blockDiagonal' fun γ =>
                                                                Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2)
                                                                  (chi.matrix α β γ)
                                                                  (MPOTensor.verticalBNTMPO (A₁ γ) i j)))
                                                            (U α β)))))

n12415.name: MPOTensor.exists_weightedVerticalProductBlock_normalDecomposition
n12415.type_full:
∀ {g d D : Nat} (dim mult : Fin g → Nat) (weight : (α : Fin g) → Fin (mult α) → Complex)
  (B : (α : Fin g) → MPSTensor (HMul.hMul D D) (dim α)) (M : MPOTensor d D)
  (U : Matrix (Fin (Finset.univ.sum fun q => MPOTensor.verticalCopyDim dim mult q)) (Fin d) Complex),
  Eq (HMul.hMul U U.conjTranspose) 1 →
    (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
        Eq (M.verticalTensor ab)
          (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul U.conjTranspose (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim mult weight B ab)) U)) →
      M.IsHorizontalCF →
        M.IsMPDO →
          ∀ (p : Prod (Sigma fun α => Fin (mult α)) (Sigma fun α => Fin (mult α))),
            Exists fun r =>
              Exists fun localDim =>
                Exists fun coefficient =>
                  Exists fun blocks =>
                    Exists fun V =>
                      And (∀ (k : Fin r), LT.lt 0 (localDim k))
                        (And (∀ (k : Fin r), LT.lt 0 (coefficient k))
                          (And (∀ (k : Fin r), (blocks k).IsNormalTensor)
                            (And (∀ (k : Fin r), Eq (HMul.hMul (V k).conjTranspose (V k)) 1)
                              (And (∀ (k l : Fin r), Ne k l → Eq (HMul.hMul (V k).conjTranspose (V l)) 0)
                                (And
                                  (∀ (k : Fin r) (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                    Eq (HMul.hMul (MPOTensor.weightedVerticalProductBlock dim mult weight B p ab) (V k))
                                      (HMul.hMul (V k) (HSMul.hSMul (coefficient k) (blocks k ab))))
                                  (And
                                    (∀ (k : Fin r) (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                      Eq
                                        (HMul.hMul (V k).conjTranspose
                                          (MPOTensor.weightedVerticalProductBlock dim mult weight B p ab))
                                        (HMul.hMul (HSMul.hSMul (coefficient k) (blocks k ab)) (V k).conjTranspose))
                                    (And
                                      (∀ (k : Fin r) (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                        Eq (HSMul.hSMul (coefficient k) (blocks k ab))
                                          (HMul.hMul
                                            (HMul.hMul (V k).conjTranspose
                                              (MPOTensor.weightedVerticalProductBlock dim mult weight B p ab))
                                            (V k)))
                                      (And
                                        (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                          Eq (MPOTensor.weightedVerticalProductBlock dim mult weight B p ab)
                                            (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
                                              HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (V k) (HSMul.hSMul (coefficient k) (blocks k ab)))
                                                (V k).conjTranspose))
                                        (And
                                          ((MPOTensor.weightedVerticalProductBlock dim mult weight B p).SameMPV₂Pos
                                            (MPSTensor.toTensorFromBlocks coefficient blocks))
                                          (LE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun k => localDim k)
                                            (HMul.hMul (dim p.1.fst) (dim p.2.fst))))))))))))

n12458.name: MPOTensor.IsHorizontalCF.exists_complete_verticalReducingProjectors
n12458.type_full:

    M.IsMPDO →
      Exists fun r =>
        Exists fun P =>
          And (∀ (k : Fin r), IsOrthogonalProjection (P k))
            (And (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => P k) 1)
              (And (∀ (k l : Fin r), Ne k l → Eq (HMul.hMul (P k) (P l)) 0)
                (∀ (k : Fin r) (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                  Eq (HMul.hMul (M.verticalTensor v) (P k)) (HMul.hMul (P k) (M.verticalTensor v)))))

n12459.name: MPOTensor.IsHorizontalCF.exists_irreducible_verticalBlockDecomp_with_isometry
n12459.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} (M : MPOTensor d D),
  M.IsHorizontalCF →
    M.IsMPDO →
      Exists fun r =>
        Exists fun dim =>
          Exists fun blocks =>
            Exists fun V =>
              And (∀ (k : Fin r), LT.lt 0 (dim k))
                (And (∀ (k : Fin r), Eq (HMul.hMul (V k).conjTranspose (V k)) 1)
                  (And (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => HMul.hMul (V k) (V k).conjTranspose) 1)
                    (And (∀ (k l : Fin r), Ne k l → Eq (HMul.hMul (V k).conjTranspose (V l)) 0)
                      (And
                        (∀ (k : Fin r) (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                          Eq (HMul.hMul (M.verticalTensor v) (V k)) (HMul.hMul (V k) (blocks k v)))
                        (And
                          (∀ (k : Fin r) (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                            Eq (HMul.hMul (V k).conjTranspose (M.verticalTensor v))
                              (HMul.hMul (blocks k v) (V k).conjTranspose))
                          (And
                            (∀ (k : Fin r) (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                              Eq (blocks k v) (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (V k).conjTranspose (M.verticalTensor v)) (V k)))
                            (And (∀ (k : Fin r), Kraus.IsIrreducibleFamily (blocks k))
                              (M.verticalTensor.SameMPV₂Pos (MPSTensor.toTensorFromBlocks (fun x => 1) blocks)))))))))

      (∀ (β : Fin g₂), LT.lt 0 (mult₂ β)) →
        (∀ (β : Fin g₂) (q : Fin (mult₂ β)), LT.lt 0 (weight₂ β q)) →
          ∀ (M : MPOTensor d D) (A₁ : (α : Fin g₁) → MPSTensor (HMul.hMul D D) (dim₁ α))
            (A₂ : (β : Fin g₂) → MPSTensor (HMul.hMul D D) (dim₂ β)),
            (M.verticalTensor.IsCPSVBasisOfNormalTensors fun α => ⟨dim₁ α, A₁ α⟩) →
              (M.blockTwo.verticalTensor.IsCPSVBasisOfNormalTensors fun β => ⟨dim₂ β, A₂ β⟩) →
                ∀ (U₁ : Matrix (Fin (Finset.univ.sum fun q => MPOTensor.verticalCopyDim dim₁ mult₁ q)) (Fin d) Complex)
                  (U₂ :
                    Matrix (Fin (Finset.univ.sum fun q => MPOTensor.verticalCopyDim dim₂ mult₂ q)) (Fin (HMul.hMul d d))
                      Complex),
                  Eq (HMul.hMul U₁ U₁.conjTranspose) 1 →
                    Eq (HMul.hMul U₂ U₂.conjTranspose) 1 →
                      ∀
                        (T :
                          LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Complex)
                            (Matrix (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d)) (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d)) Complex))
                        (S :
                          LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) (Matrix (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d)) (Prod (Fin d) (Fin d)) Complex)
                            (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Complex)),
                        IsKrausCPTP T →
                          IsKrausCPTP S →
                            (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                Eq (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul U₁ (M.verticalTensor ab)) U₁.conjTranspose)
                                  (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₁ mult₁ weight₁ A₁ ab)) →
                              (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                  Eq (M.verticalTensor ab)
                                    (HMul.hMul
                                      (HMul.hMul U₁.conjTranspose
                                        (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₁ mult₁ weight₁ A₁ ab))
                                      U₁)) →
                                (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                    Eq (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul U₂ (M.blockTwo.verticalTensor ab)) U₂.conjTranspose)
                                      (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₂ mult₂ weight₂ A₂ ab)) →
                                  (∀ (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                      Eq (M.blockTwo.verticalTensor ab)
                                        (HMul.hMul
                                          (HMul.hMul U₂.conjTranspose
                                            (MPOTensor.verticalAssembledTensor dim₂ mult₂ weight₂ A₂ ab))
                                          U₂)) →
                                    (∀ (X : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex), Eq (T (M.physClose1 X)) (M.physClose2 X)) →
                                      (∀ (X : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex),
                                          Eq (S (M.physClose2 X)) (M.physClose1 X)) →

                                          Exists fun hDim =>
                                            Exists fun V =>
                                              And
                                                (∀ (i : Fin g₁) (X : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex),
                                                  Eq ((A₂ (sigma i)).contractBondMatrix X)
                                                    (HSMul.hSMul
                                                      (HDiv.hDiv (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace weight₁ i)
                                                        (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace weight₂ (sigma i)))
                                                      (HMul.hMul
                                                        (HMul.hMul (↑(V i))
                                                          ((Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv Complex Complex (finCongr ⋯))
                                                            ((A₁ i).contractBondMatrix X)))
                                                        (↑(V i)).conjTranspose)))
                                                (∀ (i : Fin g₁) (ab : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                                  Eq (A₂ (sigma i) ab)
                                                    (HSMul.hSMul
                                                      (HDiv.hDiv (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace weight₁ i)
                                                        (MPOTensor.verticalMultiplicityTrace weight₂ (sigma i)))
                                                      (HMul.hMul
                                                        (HMul.hMul (↑(V i))

n12565.name: MPOTensor.IsHorizontalCF.exists_normal_verticalBlockDecomp_with_isometry
n12565.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} (M : MPOTensor d D),
  M.IsHorizontalCF →
    M.IsMPDO →
      Exists fun r =>
        Exists fun dim =>
          Exists fun μ =>
            Exists fun blocks =>
              Exists fun V =>
                And (∀ (k : Fin r), LT.lt 0 (dim k))
                  (And (∀ (k : Fin r), LT.lt 0 (μ k))
                    (And (∀ (k : Fin r), (blocks k).IsNormalTensor)
                      (And (∀ (k : Fin r), Eq (HMul.hMul (V k).conjTranspose (V k)) 1)
                        (And (∀ (k l : Fin r), Ne k l → Eq (HMul.hMul (V k).conjTranspose (V l)) 0)
                          (And
                            (∀ (k : Fin r) (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                              Eq (HMul.hMul (M.verticalTensor v) (V k))
                                (HMul.hMul (V k) (HSMul.hSMul (μ k) (blocks k v))))
                            (And
                              (∀ (k : Fin r) (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                Eq (HMul.hMul (V k).conjTranspose (M.verticalTensor v))
                                  (HMul.hMul (HSMul.hSMul (μ k) (blocks k v)) (V k).conjTranspose))
                              (And
                                (∀ (k : Fin r) (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                  Eq (HSMul.hSMul (μ k) (blocks k v))
                                    (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (V k).conjTranspose (M.verticalTensor v)) (V k)))
                                (∀ (v : Fin (HMul.hMul D D)),
                                  Eq (M.verticalTensor v)
                                    (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
                                      HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (V k) (HSMul.hSMul (μ k) (blocks k v)))
                                        (V k).conjTranspose)))))))))

n12816.name: MPOTensor.GroupFamily.IsRepresentation.inverseCompatibleComparison_unitary_of_inv_eq
n12816.type_full:
∀ {d : Nat} {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (F : MPOTensor.GroupFamily G d) (hF : F.IsRepresentation)
  (hcanonical : ∀ (g : G), (F.tensor g).normalizedFlattening.IsLeftCanonical) (g : G),
  Eq (Inv.inv g) g →
    ∀ (hU : (F.tensor g).IsMPUCanonicalFormII),
      have T := MPOTensor.GroupFamily.IsRepresentation.daggerInverseGauge F hF hcanonical g;
      have K := (F.tensor g).inverseCompatibleComparisonK T hU.ρ ⋯;
      have J := (F.tensor g).inverseCompatibleComparisonJ T hU.ρ ⋯;
      And K.IsUnitaryBetween
        (And (Eq J K.conjTranspose)
          (Eq
            (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul ((F.tensor g).inverseCompatibleX₁ T).conjTranspose (MPOTensor.sourceWeight hU.ρ))
              ((F.tensor g).inverseCompatibleX₁ T))
            1))

      ∀ (σ : Complex),
        Eq (HMul.hMul (↑T) ((↑T).map ⇑(starRingEnd Complex))) (HSMul.hSMul σ 1) →

n12824.name: MPOTensor.GroupFamily.IsRepresentation.inverseCompatibleSourceProperties_of_inv_eq
n12824.type_full:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {d : Nat} (F : MPOTensor.GroupFamily G d) (hF : F.IsRepresentation)
  (hcanonical : ∀ (g : G), (F.tensor g).normalizedFlattening.IsLeftCanonical) (g : G) (hg : Eq (Inv.inv g) g)
  (hU : (F.tensor g).IsMPUCanonicalFormII),
  let T := MPOTensor.GroupFamily.IsRepresentation.daggerInverseGauge F hF hcanonical g;
  let σ := MPOTensor.GroupFamily.IsRepresentation.daggerInverseScalar F hF hcanonical g;
  have S := (F.tensor g).inverseCompatibleSourceFactors T hU ⋯ ⋯ σ ⋯;
  And
    (∀ (p q : Fin d),
      And
        (Eq
          (Finset.univ.sum fun r =>
            Finset.univ.sum fun α => HMul.hMul (star (S.Y₁ r (Prod.mk α p))) (S.Y₁ r (Prod.mk α q)))
          (ite (Eq p q) 1 0))
        (Eq
          (Finset.univ.sum fun l =>
            Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
              Finset.univ.sum fun β =>
                HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (star (S.Y₂ l (Prod.mk p α))) (S.Y₂ l (Prod.mk q β))) (hU.ρ β α))
          (ite (Eq p q) 1 0)))
    (And
      (And (Eq (HMul.hMul S.Y₁ S.Y₁.conjTranspose) (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv ↑d ↑(F.tensor g).rightRank) 1))
        (Eq (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul S.Y₂ (MPOTensor.sourceWeight hU.ρ)) S.Y₂.conjTranspose)
          (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv ↑d ↑(F.tensor g).leftRank) 1)))
      (∀ (i j : Fin d),
        And
          (Eq
            (Finset.univ.sum fun r =>
              Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
                Finset.univ.sum fun β =>
                  HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (S.X₁ (Prod.mk i α) r) (hU.ρ β α)) (star (S.X₁ (Prod.mk j β) r)))
            (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv ↑(F.tensor g).rightRank ↑d) (ite (Eq i j) 1 0)))
          (Eq
            (Finset.univ.sum fun l =>
              Finset.univ.sum fun x => HMul.hMul (S.X₂ (Prod.mk x i) l) (star (S.X₂ (Prod.mk x j) l)))
            (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv ↑(F.tensor g).leftRank ↑d) (ite (Eq i j) 1 0)))))

n12885.name: MPOTensor.IsMPU.blockTensor_mul_sq_simple_contractions_of_transfer_power
n12885.type_full:

  U.IsMPU →
    ∀ (ρ : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex),
      Eq ρ.trace 1 →
        ∀ (J : Nat),

            Eq (HPow.hPow (transferMatrix (Kraus.transferMap U.normalizedFlattening)) J)
                (Matrix.vecMulVec ρ.vec (Matrix.vec 1)) →
              have ρ' := fun i => ρ.vec (finProdFinEquiv.symm i);
              have Φ' := fun i => Matrix.vec 1 (finProdFinEquiv.symm i);
              And
                (∀ (i j : Fin (MPSTensor.blockPhysDim d (HMul.hMul J (HMul.hMul D D)))),
                  Eq (dotProduct Φ' (((U.blockTensor (HMul.hMul J (HMul.hMul D D))).doubleLayerTensor i j).mulVec ρ'))
                    (ite (Eq i j) 1 0))
                (∀ (i j k l : Fin (MPSTensor.blockPhysDim d (HMul.hMul J (HMul.hMul D D)))),
                  Eq
                    (HMul.hMul ((U.blockTensor (HMul.hMul J (HMul.hMul D D))).doubleLayerTensor i j)
                      ((U.blockTensor (HMul.hMul J (HMul.hMul D D))).doubleLayerTensor k l))
                    (HMul.hMul
                      (HMul.hMul ((U.blockTensor (HMul.hMul J (HMul.hMul D D))).doubleLayerTensor i j)
                        (Matrix.vecMulVec ρ' Φ'))
                      ((U.blockTensor (HMul.hMul J (HMul.hMul D D))).doubleLayerTensor k l)))

n12992.name: MPOTensor.exists_reciprocal_unitary_source_gauges
n12992.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} {U : MPOTensor d D} {X₁ Xt₁ : Matrix (Prod (Fin d) (Fin D)) (Fin U.rightRank) Complex}
  {Y₁ Yt₁ : Matrix (Fin U.rightRank) (Prod (Fin D) (Fin d)) Complex}
  {X₂ Xt₂ : Matrix (Prod (Fin D) (Fin d)) (Fin U.leftRank) Complex}
  {Y₂ Yt₂ : Matrix (Fin U.leftRank) (Prod (Fin d) (Fin D)) Complex}
  {Lt₁ : Matrix (Fin U.rightRank) (Prod (Fin d) (Fin D)) Complex}
  {R₁ : Matrix (Prod (Fin D) (Fin d)) (Fin U.rightRank) Complex}
  {Lt₂ : Matrix (Fin U.leftRank) (Prod (Fin D) (Fin d)) Complex}
  {R₂ : Matrix (Prod (Fin d) (Fin D)) (Fin U.leftRank) Complex},
  Eq (HMul.hMul X₁ Y₁) U.sourceCutM₁ →
    Eq (HMul.hMul Xt₁ Yt₁) U.sourceCutM₁ →
      Eq (HMul.hMul X₂ Y₂) U.sourceCutM₂ →
        Eq (HMul.hMul Xt₂ Yt₂) U.sourceCutM₂ →
          Eq (HMul.hMul Lt₁ Xt₁) 1 →
            Eq (HMul.hMul Y₁ R₁) 1 →
              Eq (HMul.hMul Lt₂ Xt₂) 1 →
                Eq (HMul.hMul Y₂ R₂) 1 →
                  (Matrix.IsUnitaryBetween fun x x_1 =>
                      MPOTensor.exists_reciprocal_unitary_source_gauges.match_2 (fun x => Complex) x fun l r =>
                        MPOTensor.exists_reciprocal_unitary_source_gauges.match_1 (fun x => Complex) x_1 fun p q =>
                          Finset.univ.sum fun β => HMul.hMul (Y₂ l (Prod.mk p β)) (Y₁ r (Prod.mk β q))) →
                    (Matrix.IsUnitaryBetween fun x x_1 =>
                        MPOTensor.exists_reciprocal_unitary_source_gauges.match_3 (fun x => Complex) x fun l r =>
                          MPOTensor.exists_reciprocal_unitary_source_gauges.match_1 (fun x => Complex) x_1 fun p q =>
                            Finset.univ.sum fun β => HMul.hMul (Yt₂ l (Prod.mk p β)) (Yt₁ r (Prod.mk β q))) →
                      Exists fun δ =>
                        Exists fun x =>
                          Exists fun W₁ =>
                            Exists fun W₂ =>
                              And (Eq Xt₁ (HSMul.hSMul (Inv.inv ↑δ) (HMul.hMul X₁ ↑W₁)))
                                (And (Eq Yt₁ (HSMul.hSMul (↑δ) (HMul.hMul (star ↑W₁) Y₁)))
                                  (And (Eq Xt₂ (HSMul.hSMul (↑δ) (HMul.hMul X₂ ↑W₂)))
                                    (And (Eq Yt₂ (HSMul.hSMul (Inv.inv ↑δ) (HMul.hMul (star ↑W₂) Y₂)))
                                      (Eq (HMul.hMul (Inv.inv ↑δ) ↑δ) 1))))

n12993.name: MPOTensor.sourceU_contraction_transport
n12993.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} {U : MPOTensor d D} {Y₁ Yt₁ : Matrix (Fin U.rightRank) (Prod (Fin D) (Fin d)) Complex}
  {Y₂ Yt₂ : Matrix (Fin U.leftRank) (Prod (Fin d) (Fin D)) Complex}
  {K₁ : Matrix (Fin U.rightRank) (Fin U.rightRank) Complex} {K₂ : Matrix (Fin U.leftRank) (Fin U.leftRank) Complex},
  Eq Yt₁ (HMul.hMul K₁ Y₁) →
    Eq Yt₂ (HMul.hMul K₂ Y₂) →
      Eq
        (fun x x_1 =>
          MPOTensor.sourceU_contraction_transport.match_2 (fun x => Complex) x fun l r =>
            MPOTensor.sourceU_contraction_transport.match_1 (fun x => Complex) x_1 fun p q =>
              Finset.univ.sum fun β => HMul.hMul (Yt₂ l (Prod.mk p β)) (Yt₁ r (Prod.mk β q)))
        (HMul.hMul (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) K₂ K₁)
          (Matrix.of fun x x_1 =>
            MPOTensor.sourceU_contraction_transport.match_4 (fun x => Complex) x fun l r =>
              MPOTensor.sourceU_contraction_transport.match_3 (fun x => Complex) x_1 fun p q =>
                Finset.univ.sum fun β => HMul.hMul (Y₂ l (Prod.mk p β)) (Y₁ r (Prod.mk β q))))

n13171.name: MPOTensor.IsMPU.exists_normalized_transfer_stabilizes_to_rank_one
n13171.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} [NeZero d] [NeZero D] {U : MPOTensor d D},
  U.IsMPU →
    LT.lt 1 D →
      Exists fun J =>
        And (LT.lt 0 J)
          (And (LE.le J (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul D D) 1))
            (Exists fun ρ =>
              Exists fun Φ =>
                And (Eq (dotProduct Φ ρ) 1)
                  (And (Eq ((transferMatrix (Kraus.transferMap U.normalizedFlattening)).mulVec ρ) ρ)
                    (And (Eq (Matrix.vecMul Φ (transferMatrix (Kraus.transferMap U.normalizedFlattening))) Φ)
                      (And
                        (Eq (HPow.hPow (transferMatrix (Kraus.transferMap U.normalizedFlattening)) J)
                          (Matrix.vecMulVec ρ Φ))
                        (∀ (k : Nat),
                          LE.le J k →
                            Eq (HPow.hPow (transferMatrix (Kraus.transferMap U.normalizedFlattening)) k)
                              (HPow.hPow (transferMatrix (Kraus.transferMap U.normalizedFlattening)) J)))))))

n13173.name: MPOTensor.IsMPU.normalized_transfer_power_eq_vecMulVec_of_reduced_cfii
n13173.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} [NeZero d] [NeZero D] {U : MPOTensor d D},
  U.IsMPU →
    LT.lt 1 D →
      ∀ (cfii : U.normalizedFlattening.CPSVCanonicalFormIIData),
        cfii.HasFullSupport →
          Exists fun k =>
            Exists fun Λ =>
              Exists fun ρ =>
                And (∀ (l : Fin cfii.r), Eq l k)
                  (And Λ.PosDef
                    (And Λ.IsDiag
                      (And (Eq Λ.trace 1)
                        (And (Eq ((Kraus.transferMap (cfii.blocks k)) Λ) Λ)
                          (And
                            (Eq ρ
                              (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (cfii.ambientBlockInclusion k) Λ)
                                (cfii.ambientBlockInclusion k).conjTranspose))
                            (And ρ.PosDef
                              (And (Eq ρ.trace 1)
                                (And (Eq ((Kraus.transferMap U.normalizedFlattening) ρ) ρ)
                                  (And
                                    (Eq
                                      (Matrix.vecMul (Matrix.vec 1)
                                        (transferMatrix (Kraus.transferMap U.normalizedFlattening)))
                                      (Matrix.vec 1))
                                    (Eq
                                      (HPow.hPow (transferMatrix (Kraus.transferMap U.normalizedFlattening))
                                        (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul D D) 1))
                                      (Matrix.vecMulVec ρ.vec (Matrix.vec 1))))))))))))

              (Ifull.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (A.groundSpaceMapES (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd K l) 1)))))))))

n13663.name: MPSTensor.IsPrimitiveMPS.groundSpaceGram_geometric_inverse_bounds
n13663.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} [inst : NeZero D] {A : MPSTensor d D} {ρ : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex},
  A.IsPrimitiveMPS ρ →
    ∀ (hρ : ρ.PosDef),
      have Kinf := Matrix.gramReshuffle (fixedPointProj ρ ⋯);
      have Iinf := Ring.inverse Kinf;
      Exists fun g =>
        Exists fun c =>
          Exists fun r =>
            And (LT.lt 0 g)
              (And (LT.lt 0 c)
                (And (LT.lt 0 r)
                  (And (LT.lt r 1)
                    (And (Eq c (HMul.hMul (norm Iinf) g))
                      (∀ (n : Nat),
                        LE.le 1 n →

                              (Matrix.diagonal

n13982.name: MPSTensor.pgvwc07_complementary_word_cde_identities_of_trace_decomposition
n13982.type_full:
∀ {d r : Nat} {dim : Fin r → Nat} (A : (j : Fin r) → MPSTensor d (dim j)) {m K M : Nat},
  MPSTensor.WordTupleSpanTop A m →
    ∀ (X : (j : Fin r) → Matrix (Fin (dim j)) (Fin (dim j)) Complex)
      (C : (j : Fin r) → (Fin M → Fin d) → Matrix (Fin (dim j)) (Fin (dim j)) Complex),
      (∀ (j : Fin r), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun a => HMul.hMul (A j a) (A j a).conjTranspose) 1) →
        (∀ (ρ : Fin M → Fin d) (β : Fin K → Fin d) (w : Fin m → Fin d),
            Eq
              (Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
                (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (Kraus.evalWord (A j) (List.ofFn β)) (C j ρ))
                    (Kraus.evalWord (A j) (List.ofFn w))).trace)
              (Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
                (HMul.hMul
                    (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (X j) (Kraus.evalWord (A j) (List.ofFn β)))
                      (Kraus.evalWord (A j) (List.ofFn ρ)))
                    (Kraus.evalWord (A j) (List.ofFn w))).trace)) →
          ∀ (j : Fin r),
            Exists fun E =>
              And (Eq E (Finset.univ.sum fun ρ => HMul.hMul (C j ρ) (Kraus.evalWord (A j) (List.ofFn ρ)).conjTranspose))
                (And
                  (∀ (β : Fin K → Fin d),
                    Eq (HMul.hMul (X j) (Kraus.evalWord (A j) (List.ofFn β)))
                      (HMul.hMul (Kraus.evalWord (A j) (List.ofFn β)) E))
                  (∀ (ρ : Fin M → Fin d) (β : Fin K → Fin d),
                    Eq (HMul.hMul (Kraus.evalWord (A j) (List.ofFn β)) (C j ρ))
                      (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (Kraus.evalWord (A j) (List.ofFn β)) E)
                        (Kraus.evalWord (A j) (List.ofFn ρ)))))

n14119.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} [inst : NeZero D] (A : MPSTensor d D) (K L Q : Nat) (ρ : Matrix (Fin D) (Fin D) Complex) (hρ : ρ.PosDef)
  (hLocalTail : Function.Injective ⇑(A.groundSpaceMapES (HAdd.hAdd L Q)))
  (hLocalLeft : Function.Injective ⇑(A.groundSpaceMapES (HAdd.hAdd K L))),
  have Kinf := Matrix.gramReshuffle (fixedPointProj ρ ⋯);
  have Iinf := Ring.inverse Kinf;
  have Itail := (A.groundSpaceMapES (HAdd.hAdd L Q)).inverseGram hLocalTail;
  have Ileft := (A.groundSpaceMapES (HAdd.hAdd K L)).inverseGram hLocalLeft;
  LE.le (norm (A.wholeIncrementLeftFiniteGramCorrectionES K L Q ρ hρ hLocalTail hLocalLeft))
    (HMul.hMul
      (HMul.hMul
        (HMul.hMul
          (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (norm Itail).sqrt (norm Kinf)) (norm (A.tailVirtualMapES K))) (norm Iinf))
          (norm (A.leftVirtualMapES Q)))
        (norm (HSub.hSub (A.groundSpaceGram (HAdd.hAdd K L)) Kinf)))
      (norm Ileft).sqrt)

n14424.name: MPSTensor.IsNNCPH.exists_unitary_blockActions_of_twoSiteParentInteractionMatrix
n14424.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} {A : MPSTensor d D},
  A.IsNNCPH 3 →
    Exists fun K =>
      Exists fun dl =>
        Exists fun dr =>
          Exists fun e =>
            Exists fun U =>
              Exists fun R =>
                Exists fun S =>
                  And (Membership.mem (Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) Complex) U)
                    (And (∀ (q : Fin K), LT.lt 0 (dl q))
                      (And (∀ (q : Fin K), LT.lt 0 (dr q))
                        (And (∀ (q : Fin K), (R q).IsHermitian)
                          (And (∀ (q : Fin K), (S q).IsHermitian)
                            (And
                              (Eq
                                ((Matrix.reindex (Matrix.leftSpatialBlockEquiv e).symm
                                    (Matrix.leftSpatialBlockEquiv e).symm)
                                  (HMul.hMul
                                    (HMul.hMul (star (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) 1 U))
                                      A.twoSiteParentInteractionMatrix)
                                    (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) 1 U)))
                                (Matrix.blockDiagonal' fun q =>
                                  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) (R q) 1))
                              (Eq
                                ((Matrix.reindex (Matrix.rightSpatialBlockEquiv e).symm
                                    (Matrix.rightSpatialBlockEquiv e).symm)
                                  (HMul.hMul
                                    (HMul.hMul (star (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) U 1))
                                      A.twoSiteParentInteractionMatrix)
                                    (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) U 1)))
                                (Matrix.blockDiagonal' fun q =>
                                  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => HMul.hMul x1 x2) 1 (S q))))))))

n14715.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (A : MPSTensor d D),
  Kraus.IsInjective A →
    ∀ (U : MonoidHom G (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Complex)),
      A.IsOnSiteSymmetric U →
        Exists fun ω =>
          Exists fun ρ =>
            ∀ (g : G) (i : Fin d),
              Eq (A.twistedTensor U g i)
                (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (↑(ρ.X (Inv.inv g))) (A i)) (MPSTensor.invMat (ρ.X (Inv.inv g))))

n14716.name: MPSTensor.virtual_rep_of_symmetric_injective_cocycle
n14716.type_full:
∀ {d D : Nat} {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (A : MPSTensor d D),
  Kraus.IsInjective A →
    ∀ (U : MonoidHom G (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Complex)),
      A.IsOnSiteSymmetric U →
        LT.lt 0 D →
          Exists fun ω =>
            Exists fun ρ =>
              And
                (∀ (g : G) (i : Fin d),
                  Eq (A.twistedTensor U g i)
                    (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (↑(ρ.X (Inv.inv g))) (A i)) (MPSTensor.invMat (ρ.X (Inv.inv g)))))
                (∀ (g h k : G),
                  Eq (HMul.hMul ↑(ω g h) ↑(ω (HMul.hMul g h) k)) (HMul.hMul ↑(ω g (HMul.hMul h k)) ↑(ω h k)))

    ∀ (U : MonoidHom G (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Complex)) (X : G → Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin D) Complex),
